newsitem.title: USA: MEDICAL INDUSTRIES TO PROBE TRANSACTIONS.
newsitem.headline: MEDICAL INDUSTRIES TO PROBE TRANSACTIONS.

text.p: Medical Industries of America Inc said Thursday it has hired two law firms to investigate all transactions carried out under the company's former management.

President and Chief Operating Officer Paul Pershes said in a statement that in the past, "acquisitions were made without consideration to how they complemented the core business. Our acquisition strategy is very focused and specific to the medical field."
The company said it expects a report on those transactions will be issued in the fourth quarter of this year.
The company said it will "never again" raise needed capital through a Regulation S private placement.

"Medical Industries will never do another Regulation S transaction so long as either Michael Morrell or I are with the company," Pershes said. "For the past nine months, we have worked relentlessly to overcome serious challenges and situations that have historically and negatively impacted Medical Industries' bottom line for a number of years."
A spokesman did not immediately return a telephone call seeking further information.

Medical Industries, through its wholly owned subsidiary, Florida Physicians Internet Inc, operates a multi-specialty medical group practice. The company also provides diagnostic and therapeutic healthcare services to the surgical and medical community.
